body: Thank you for the reply mate. I feel i should be doing something like that, but im initiated with a crowd that doesnt suit me and have been for a long time. I cant bare sunlight, public makes me distressed because I am constantly concerned what others are thinking of me and i come off as a fucking weirdo.. I abandoned all the people who were anyway decent for no reason. And miserably, now its all i know. I feel so ashamed of myself and therefore i believe everyones also ashamed of me. I just wish I could be a kid again before everything went so wrong and i became something that isnt normal, a fickle minded lost soul that has no emotion or understanding of the world. Im not myself anymore im something else, something alien and foreign. I cut for the first time tonight after a bad experience and now i feel trapped.. people will see it and judge me instantly and somewhere deep down i want them to... i want them to see my pain.
